sql_templates.description: Fetch latest quarterly results with revenue and PAT growth for companies.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_quarterly AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (qr.symbol) qr.symbol, qr.period_end, qr.revenue, qr.pat, ra.growth_yoy_revenue_pct, ra.growth_yoy_pat_pct
  FROM scores.quarterly_results qr
  JOIN scores.results_analysis ra ON ra.symbol = qr.symbol AND ra.period_end = qr.period_end
  ORDER BY qr.symbol, qr.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, qr.fetched_at DESC
)
SELECT sqr.symbol, sqr.company_name, sqr.industry, sqr.revenue as latest_revenue, sqr.pat as latest_pat, ra.growth_yoy_revenue_pct, ra.growth_yoy_pat_pct
FROM latest_quarterly lq
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots sqr ON sqr.symbol = lq.symbol
WHERE lq.period_end > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
ORDER BY sqr.industry, ra.growth_yoy_revenue_pct DESC
LIMIT 100;
